{"check": "from slugify import slugify
from slugify.__main__ import parse_args, slugify_params

def test_regex_forwarded_none():
    params = slugify_params(parse_args(['slugify', 'Hello']))
    assert params['regex_pattern'] is None
    assert slugify(**params) == 'hello'

def test_regex_forwarded_custom():
    pattern = r'[^a-z_]+'
    params = slugify_params(parse_args(['slugify', 'Hello_42', '--regex-pattern', pattern]))
    assert params['regex_pattern'] == pattern
    assert slugify(**params) == 'hello_'

def test_other_options_preserved():
    params = slugify_params(parse_args(['slugify', 'A B', '--separator', '_', '--no-lowercase']))
    assert params['separator'] == '_'
    assert params['lowercase'] is False
    assert params['regex_pattern'] is None
    assert slugify(**params) == 'A_B'

def test_iterable_options_still_work():
    reps = iter([('|', 'or'), iter(['%', 'percent'])])
    assert slugify('a|b%c', replacements=reps) == 'aorborpercentc'
    sw = iter(['the'])
    assert slugify('the quick the', stopwords=sw) == 'quick'"}
